question: What was India’s rank in the World Press Freedom Index 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __142__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Norway retained its top position on the World Press Freedom Index, 2020.​ 
 
• The World Press Freedom Index:
 
 
• It is published by an NGO, ‘Reporters Sans Frontieres' or ‘Reporters without Borders.'
 
• India has ranked 142 out of 180 countries in the 2020 index.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• World Press Freedom Index 2019:

 
 
• ​Norway was ranked 1st in the list.
 
• India ranked 140th.
